item.title: Morgan gifts heaters
item.description: Lafayette County District 2 Supervisor John Morgan purchased a large number of kerosene heaters and kerosene oil for his constituents. On Monday, Morgan and other volunteers set up across Little John’s to distribute the heaters on a first-come, first-served basis. The heaters were gifted to folks who proved they were District 2 residents. The money for the heaters was donated by four community members.
